services.name: Deer Creek Sunset Tours
services.desc: Experience the Provo River Rafting “best guided rafting trip” - according to Outdoor Magazine - through the unforgettable beauty of the Provo River. This trip is perfect for enjoying what photographers call the ‘magic hour’, where the light is just right and the wildlife comes out. There will be plenty of time to relax as your experienced, certified and licensed guide navigates your inflatable raft through the winding canyon walls towering above you. You will enjoy a two-hour trip with snacks and fun surrounded by one of Utah’s most beautiful canyons and flanked by 11,800 ft Mount Timpanogos, home of Robert Redford’s Sundance Resort. blurb: Surrounded by snowcapped mountains, lakes and rivers, Midway, Utah is visually stunning. Located just minutes from Park City, your adventure is waiting. Midway is a mountain valley surrounded by state parks, national forests and world class skiing. Numerous campgrounds, RV parks and hotels are near Midway’s quaint swiss Main Street area.
